shared_elements: curvilinear linear motifs incised/painted on natural rock outcrop
broad open curve / crescent-like arc forms
justification: Both surfaces present sparse, schematic curvilinear marks placed on the irregular face of a natural boulder, with hook and arc shapes that are broadly comparable in their linear, outline-only manner. However, A shows small thin-line figures (a quadruped-like sign, an open crescent-bounded shape) scattered with clear space between them, while B's carvings are large spiral/eye-like and broad relief motifs filling the boulder faces; no specific motif or relationship recurs in both, and B is largely too distant to read detailed content.
